title: Guest Host Channel Handshake Law
description: The app-channel version a guest was compiled for, read once right after instantiation and before any frame, against its host's own version. Each case offsets the guest from the host's CHANNEL_VERSION (the pin), so the corpus stays true across bumps; a refused case names the fault code and the placeholder values its framework notice is filled from.

guestOffset.description: The guest's compiled version minus the host's.
